title: If My People Humble Themselves
question: What does God ask of a people who have wandered?
blurb: Four verbs and a promise, spoken over a newly built temple. See where else they show up.

nodes.content: What does God ask of a people who have wandered?

nodes.verseText: and if My people who are called by My name humble themselves and pray and seek My face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, forgive their sin, and heal their land.
If I close the sky so there is no rain, or if I command the locust to devour the land, or if I send a plague among My people,
The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, You will not despise.
Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.
If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
